content.content:
Order service API

All responses are JSON unless noted. Requests are made to the address this service is running on.

GET /docs
    This page (plain text).

GET /value
    Returns {"value": <integer>}. No authentication.

POST /token
    Returns {"token": "<token>"}. No authentication. Send the token on authenticated
    requests in the header "Authorization: Bearer <token>".

GET /orders?page=N
    Authenticated. Lists orders, 50 per page; N starts at 1.
    Returns {"page", "total_pages", "items", "next"}. "next" is the path of the following
    page, or null on the last page.
    Each order has: id, customer_id, status, placed_at, amount_cents.
    status is one of: placed, shipped, cancelled, returned.
    placed_at is an ISO 8601 timestamp. amount_cents is an integer number of cents.

GET /customers/{id}
    Authenticated. Returns {"id", "name", "region", "tier", "discount_pct"}; 404 if the id is unknown.
    region is one of: north, south, east, west. discount_pct is a whole-number percentage.

mkdir -p /tmp/work && cat > /tmp/work/r.py <<'EOF'
import json,time,urllib.request,urllib.error
from datetime import datetime,timezone
B="http://localhost:8080"; tok=None; log=[]
def req(path,method="GET",auth=True):
    global tok
    for i in range(200):
        h={}
        if auth:
            if not tok: tok=req("/token","POST",False)["token"]
            h["Authorization"]="Bearer "+tok
        r=urllib.request.Request(B+path,method=method,headers=h,data=b"" if method=="POST" else None)
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=30) as resp: return json.loads(resp.read())
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
            body=e.read()[:200]; log.append((path,e.code,body))
            if e.code==401: tok=None; continue
            if e.code==429: time.sleep(float(e.headers.get("Retry-After") or 1)); continue
            if e.code==404 and path.startswith("/customers"): return None
            time.sleep(0.5)
        except Exception as e: log.append((path,str(e))); time.sleep(0.5)
    raise SystemExit("fail "+path)
orders={};dups=0;p="/orders?page=1";pages=0
while p:
    d=req(p);pages+=1
    for o in d["items"]:
        if o["id"] in orders:
            dups+=1
            if orders[o["id"]]!=o: print("DIFF",orders[o["id"]],o)
        else: orders[o["id"]]=o
    p=d["next"]
print("pages",pages,d["total_pages"],"orders",len(orders),"dups",dups)
lo=datetime(2025,3,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc);hi=datetime(2025,6,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
cust={};tot=0;n=0;reg={k:0 for k in["north","south","east","west"]};odd=set()
for o in orders.values():
    odd.add(o["status"])
    if o["status"]!="shipped": continue
    s=o["placed_at"].replace("Z","+00:00");t=datetime.fromisoformat(s)
    if t.tzinfo is None: print("naive",s); t=t.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    if not(lo<=t.astimezone(timezone.utc)<hi): continue
    c=o["customer_id"]
    if c not in cust: cust[c]=req(f"/customers/{c}")
    C=cust[c]
    if C is None: print("missing cust",o); continue
    v=(o["amount_cents"]*(100-C["discount_pct"])*2+100)//200
    tot+=v;n+=1;reg[C["region"]]+=v
print("statuses",odd)
from collections import Counter;print(Counter((x[1] if len(x)>2 else x[1]) for x in log))
print([x for x in log if len(x)>2 and x[1] not in(401,429)][:5])
json.dump({"total_cents":tot,"order_count":n,"duplicates_skipped":dups,"by_region":reg},open("/workspace/result.json","w"),indent=2)
print(open("/workspace/result.json").read(), sum(reg.values())==tot)
EOF
python3 -I /tmp/work/r.py

content.text:
I've written `/workspace/result.json`. The spring quarter total for shipped orders after discounts is **9,329,707 cents**, from **407** distinct orders.

| Region | Cents |
|---|---|
| North | 2,666,579 |
| South | 2,714,624 |
| East | 1,671,579 |
| West | 2,276,925 |

The four regions add up exactly to the total.

- **Coverage:** I fetched all 30 pages of the order listing, 1,480 distinct orders in all. When the service said a token had expired or asked me to wait, I got a new token or waited the time it gave and tried again. Every request eventually succeeded, so no data is missing.
- **Duplicates:** 20 repeat listings were thrown away. Each one was identical to the first copy of that order, so it made no difference which copy was kept.
- **Calculation:** Orders count only if their status is exactly "shipped" and their time, converted to UTC, falls between 1 March 2025 00:00 and the end of 31 May 2025. Each order's discount was rounded half up to a whole cent before summing.

Nothing in the data surprised me. Every timestamp had a time zone, every status was one of the four listed, and every customer was found. The docs also list an unauthenticated `/value` endpoint that has nothing to do with this job, so I didn't use it. My working script is in `/tmp/work`, outside the workspace.
